leadText:
Marin (Japanese: マリン Marin) is a minor recurring character in Pokémon Journeys: The Series.

Marin first appeared in The Cuteness Quotient!, in which she competed in the Friendship Festival with her . At the awards ceremony, Marin appeared on stage with a trophy, although it remained unknown if she won the competition.

Marin reappeared in On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!, where she was among the competitors taking part in the Kids Marine Athletic Race. She ended up finishing eighth.
